title: UI mockups
summary: Designs an app's screens as distinctive, accessible, static HTML mockups that click through: one self-contained file per screen, token-driven CSS, mobile and desktop layouts, real content and every key state.
changes: Renamed from frontend-design to ui-mockups; new 'Use when' description; dropped the license frontmatter key (Apache-2.0 text is in LICENSE.txt).

Kept the upstream aesthetic guidance near verbatim: grounding in the subject, typography, structure-as-information, the calibration list of AI-design defaults, the two-pass plan/review process, restraint and self-critique, and the writing-in-design section.

Adapted for static HTML with no JavaScript: the hero options drop animation, live demo and interactive moments; typeface choice is limited to system font stacks (new references/system-font-stacks.md); the motion paragraph now covers CSS-only hover/focus states and reduced motion; 'write the code' became 'build screens'; 'confirm with the client' became 'confirm with the user'; existing brand tokens are treated as the visual direction.

Added 'Mockup rules: static HTML, no JavaScript' (self-contained files, no script, no external resources, identical token block as CSS custom properties, relative links between screens, forms that navigate, native details/:target interactivity, mobile-first media queries, realistic content, designed empty/loading/error states) and 'The screen set' (flows, file naming, an index page, reachability, identical shared components).

Merged from wshobson visual-design-foundations: spacing values for components, line-height ranges, limiting weights/families, missing-states and magic-number failure modes; dropped its Tailwind, React/TSX, @font-face and web-font pairing examples.

Merged from wshobson responsive-design: mobile-first, content-driven breakpoints, fluid values, 44px touch targets, horizontal overflow and 100vh pitfalls; dropped container-query and image-loading material that does not apply to the format.

Merged from wshobson accessibility-compliance: semantic HTML first, visible focus, labels, 200% zoom, reduced motion; corrected the large-text threshold to WCAG's 24px regular / about 18.7px bold (upstream visual-design-foundations says 18px+) and dropped the testing-tools list and screen-reader/live-region items that need scripting.
Added references/screen-skeleton.md (an example screen file) and references/mockup-checklist.md (pre-delivery checklist), written for Drydock.
